[Rating: 1/10] Its not a broken game; I just hate this game more than most any other!  Every time I've played this game I've been one of the first ones to die leaving me with nothing to do while everyone else spins their yarns.  No more, never again, I will not play this again.  I normally don't mind elimination games but this one I do not care for in the least.

[Rating: 1/10] what the F*$ù about this game? i can't understand why it is so well ranked. Don't need it, just use your imagination, some paper and a pen. Please save 20$

[Rating: 1/10] A novelty the first 2 times but after that it was very much the same game over and over.  Play usually starts with someone saying, "You have a big beard and thick eyebrows so you must be a werewolf."  Maybe the wrong crowd but it was pretty dull. Good if you want to involve a big group. Replayability is low.

[Rating: 1/10] Secret role guessing game, something to pass the time at a big convention, but even then unremarkable.

[Rating: 1/10] Player elimination = lame; broken mechanic; people eliminate you without rationale; too long for an elimination game & there is nothing interesting to watch once you are out.  Basically, it comes down to whoever can screams the loudest or who has favorable reliationships within the group.

[Rating: 1/10] What a crap game. Nothing worse than being eliminated on the first round and watching people randomly accusing each other for 30 minutes. Play Resistance or Avalon if you want a really fun hidden role game.
